text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: page fired for service=redwood-inference.api metric=latency.p99.us-west threshold=2.4s (SLO=1.2s). Incident PD-INC-4721. Runbook: /runbooks/latency-slo.md. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/insights/PD-INC-4721

oncall_jay: Acked. I'm on it — checking dashboards and logs.

emma_sre: Quick snapshot: p95 ~900ms, p99 ~2.6s across us-west. CPU on inference-pool-us-west at 78%. Request rate +30% compared to baseline (sudden traffic spike from a batched job?). Pulling recent traces.

ops_lead: Noted. Any customer-facing errors or 5xxs? @maya_support can you check CS queue?

maya_support: No major error spikes in Zendesk yet. A couple of enterprise users in EU reported slower responses ~10m ago but no formal tickets. I'll proactively message account reps. :eyes: 

tina_reliability: Immediate mitigation options: 1) bump replicas in us-west, 2) route a small percent to fallback smaller model (gpt-small-quant) to reduce tail latency, 3) warm KV cache for hot prefixes. Recommend scale-up + KV warmup first.

oncall_jay: Kicking scale now. Running: `kubectl scale deployment inference-us-west --replicas=12` — will monitor.

emma_sre: Noticed high KV miss rate for hotkey "user:session_prompt". Starting prefix warmup for top hotkeys. Running warm script:```
./tools/warm_kv.sh --region us-west --keys hotkey_list.txt
```

pd-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-4721 updated — ACK by oncall_jay. Auto-escalation to L2 in 10m if no improvement.

ops_lead: Good. If p99 doesn't drop below 1.8s within 8 minutes, prepare to flip 10% traffic to fallback model and schedule a canary route. Keep CS updated.

oncall_jay: Scale-up finished and warmup kicked off. Watching the effect now — expect visible change in ~2-3 minutes.

emma_sre: Metrics update: p99 down to 1.92s, p95 740ms and trending downward. CPU usage falling to 65%. KV hitrate improving. Looks like mitigations are helping.

maya_support: FYI — messaged top 3 accounts in US and EU with advisory. No elevated support escalations.

oncall_jay: Interim mitigation: autoscale + KV warmup. Will keep PD incident open and monitor for 30m stability window before close.

pd-bot: Reminder: PD-INC-4721 will auto-escalate at 1795551711 if not resolved.

ops_lead: Thanks team — keep thumbs on metrics. If anything regresses, call for routing flip ASAP. :thumbsup:
